full_prompt_en: A square bright anime illustration shows a cheerful young boy with sharply spiked black hair smiling upward against a glowing orange background. The selected picture is tightly cropped, showing the head, shoulders, and upper torso with a little space around the hair points. Behind him, yellow-orange light fills the upper left, while angular warm-brown structures or patterned surfaces recede diagonally toward the lower right. The background remains intentionally loose and indistinct, its bright streaks giving a sense of lively movement rather than a specific setting. The boy stands near the center, his face tilted up toward the viewer. Several tall black hair spikes rise beyond the top edge, with narrow greenish highlights along some tips. His large round brown eyes have bright white reflections and clear dark outlines. The eyebrows lift, the small nose is marked by a compact shadow, and the mouth opens wide in an unguarded smile. The cheeks and forehead are smooth warm peach, with simple cel-style shading beneath the chin and along the sides of the face. He wears a dark green high-collared jacket with red trim and a red vertical fastening line. The collar wraps the neck and draws the eye back toward the smiling face. A shoulder angles toward the lower-left corner, giving the upper body a slight forward lean. The strongest light comes from the upper left behind him, illuminating the warm background and adding a narrow glow at the hair edges, while the front of the jacket stays deeper green. No readable text appears in the selected image. The overall composition is energetic and friendly, using a simple expressive face and dark-green silhouette against radiant orange to create immediate warmth.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形明亮动漫插画呈现一位头发高高竖起的年轻男孩，在发光橙色背景前仰头欢笑。所选画面裁切紧密，露出头部、肩膀和上半身，发尖周围留少量空处。身后黄橙光填满左上，棱角状暖棕构造或带图案表面向右下斜退。背景刻意保持松散模糊，明亮条纹带来活泼动势，而不指向明确场所。男孩位于中央附近，面孔向观者抬起。几根高高的黑色发尖越过上边缘，有些发端带狭窄微绿高光。大而圆的棕眼睛里有明亮白反光，深色轮廓清楚。眉毛抬起，小鼻子由紧凑阴影标出，嘴巴大张，露出毫无保留的笑容。脸颊和额头是平滑的暖桃色，下巴与脸侧带简洁的赛璐璐式阴影。他穿一件深绿色高领外套，配红色滚边及竖向红色扣合线。领口围住脖子，把目光重新引向笑脸。一侧肩膀朝左下角斜去，使上半身略有前倾。最强的光来自身后左上，照亮暖背景，并在发缘添上窄窄光亮，外套正面保持较深绿色。所选图像没有可读文字。整体构图充满能量且亲切，以简洁富表情的面孔与深绿剪影对照放射般橙光，立刻传达暖意。
style_prompt_en: The bright anime treatment uses thick clean contours, oversized simple expressive shapes, and broad cel-shaded color planes. Dark green and near-black establish a compact focal silhouette against saturated orange, ocher, and golden light. Small white highlights punctuate dark focal areas, creating lively sparkle without complex rendering. Angular background strokes recede diagonally and remain loose, so the central expression stays crisp. Warm backlight picks out upper edges, while frontal planes are shaded in two or three decisive values rather than continuous gradients. Proportions are youthful and exaggerated, with sharp outer points balancing round inner shapes. The crop is close and direct, allowing very little empty margin around the principal form. Fine painterly grain appears behind the smooth character coloring and keeps the warm field from becoming flat. The overall effect is optimistic, vigorous, and instantly readable, with color contrast and confident line art doing the main work.
style_prompt_zh: 这种明亮动漫处理使用厚而干净的轮廓、夸张而简洁的表情形状，以及宽阔赛璐璐明暗色面。深绿与近黑在饱和橙、赭黄和金光前建立紧凑焦点剪影。细小白高光点在深色焦点区域，产生活泼闪烁，而无需复杂渲染。棱角状背景笔触斜向后退且保持松散，使中央神情依然锐利。暖逆光挑出上部边缘，正面色面则只用两三档果断明度塑形，而非连续渐层。比例带稚气并有所夸张，尖锐外部形状平衡圆润内部形状。裁切贴近而直接，让主要大形周围几乎没有多余边距。细微绘画颗粒出现在平滑着色后方，避免暖色色域变成纯平面。整体效果乐观、有力且立即可读，色彩对比与自信线描承担主要视觉工作。
theme_en: A cheerful spiky-haired boy in green against a glowing orange background
theme_zh: 绿衣刺发男孩在发光橙色背景前开怀大笑
name: Hunter x Hunter
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
